scope: Nine fixed source/mask frames per clip at +1,+30,+60,+90,+120,+150,+180,+210,+239 seconds; supplemented by earlier short source/target replays, not continuous review of all clips.
model_scope: Four weak appearance-edge probability heads, source timestamps retained. Screen namespaces are not pooled into light-field targets. No hold labels.
forest_role: Repeatedly inspected development-transfer evaluation, not untouched test
uncertainty: Appearance edges may reflect exposure, clipping, occlusions or screen spill. Full-horizon geometry masks do not make scene observations clean fixture signals.
